about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Extended (formerly X10) tracking BP p.l.c. (BP), with pricing referencing Extended oracle (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to BP p.l.c. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Starknet.
